diameterInterpretation: Approximate scale from a thermal diameter of 47.78 ± 2 km. Quoted uncertainty does not fully include thermal-model and viewing-geometry effects.

calibration.quantity: mean radiometric diameter from IRAS flux-based albedo and H
calibration.notes: Quoted 1σ uncertainty derives solely from IRAS flux precision (original label DIAM_UNC). It does not encompass shape/thermal-model/H systematic uncertainty.
calibration.basis: effective spherical radiometric diameter applied as approximate volume-equivalent size
calibration.assumption: Uniformly scale the independently inferred convex shape to the reported effective thermal diameter. This does not establish a measured volume or shape-matched thermophysical calibration; quoted catalog errors exclude shape/orientation and survey systematic uncertainty.
